[SWS_CM_10473] E2E Error Response
⌈
The client shall map the error
message [SWS_CM_10472] to the error domain ara::com::E2EError.
⌋

[SWS_CM_10473] Handling the E2E Error Response
⌈
Handling of an E2E
error response message (sent due to a detected E2E error in request according to
[SWS_CM_10472]) shall be done in the same way as the reception and the handling
of any other error response message according to the used network binding (e.g., ac-
cording to [SWS_CM_10429] in case of SOME/IP network binding).
⌋
